title: feat(runtime): createInProcessAuthoringRegistry, the light authoring door in process as the signed-in user
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoS1QowAYaTNxdd2oGhyXWGh)_

Fixes #37944

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读
- 用户能看到什么变化：用户无感；云端问 AI 的管理员技能今后可以在服务器进程内、以当前登录用户身份调用框架的五个搭建工具（读元数据、存草稿、删草稿），不需要 OAuth 授权。
- 为什么做：云端问 AI 管理员技能（云端 M2 第一项）要用框架这套工具，否则云端得再抄一份约七百行、会和框架走样的副本。
- 出错会怎样：只影响管理员在应用内让 AI 存草稿；准入仍是本人的元数据管理权限，草稿照旧要人在 Studio 审阅后发布，合入后可直接回退。
- 要你做什么：无。

## What changes

- **Docs**: `packages/runtime/README.md` gains an *In-process authoring tools* section under API Reference (the package's published record of its API). `content/docs/permissions/system-context.mdx` gains row **61c** (the entry admits a system context nothing) with its regenerated register line, because the entry's fail-closed guard reads `isSystem`.
- **New public entry** `createInProcessAuthoringRegistry(kernel, { executionContext, environmentId })` from `@objectstack/runtime` (`packages/runtime/src/in-process-authoring.ts`, beside `action-dispatch.ts`). It returns `{ admitted, getAll(), execute(toolCall) }`: the five tools of the MCP draft door (`list_metadata_items`, `get_metadata_item`, `list_drafts`, `save_metadata_draft`, `delete_metadata_draft`), bound to one signed-in person for one turn. Exported types: `InProcessAuthoringRequest`, `InProcessAuthoringRegistry`, `OpenAuthoringToolCall`, `OpenAuthoringToolResult`.
- **One implementation.** The MCP door's assembly is factored out as `buildOpenAuthoringRegistry(deps, context, principal)` in `mcp-authoring.ts`; `resolveOpenAuthoringInjection` (the MCP door) and the new entry both call it. The private builders (`resolveHumanReader`, `openWriter`, `openReadGateSources`) are unchanged in body and still take `DomainHandlerDeps` + `HttpProtocolContext`; no second copy exists.
- **Placement, as `dispatchAction`.** The entry takes the host kernel and runs on the same shared per-kernel `HttpDispatcher` as `dispatchAction` (`hostDispatcherFor(kernel)`, extracted in `action-dispatch.ts`; `dispatchAction` and `dispatchActionResume` bodies untouched). `HttpDispatcher.hostAuthoringRegistry(request)` places the request with the same `placeHostActionRequest` step a host action call uses, so the tools read the environment's services exactly as the MCP door reads them, including the classified `tenancy` and knowledge lookups. A resolver that refuses to place the request rejects the call.
- **Admission** is the human half only: the person's own `manage_metadata`, decided by `resolveHumanReader` exactly as for the MCP door. A person without it is listed no tool and every call is refused `403 PERMISSION_DENIED` (the MCP door's shape; the sentence drops the `metadata:write` half, which does not exist here). Fail closed: an envelope with no `userId`, an `isSystem` envelope, or a grant read that throws admits nothing.
- **Provenance**: saves through the entry state `surface: 'copilot'` and no `client`. The MCP door keeps `surface: 'mcp'` with the token's client.
- No publish tool. The MCP door's behaviour is unchanged (its whole test file is green unmodified above the new group).

### Why `copilot`, not the card's example `in_app` (seat ruling, claim amendment 7219051191)

The card asks for a value "other than `'mcp'`" so Studio and the host's caps can tell the in-app path from MCP. `MetadataAuthoringSurfaceSchema` already has that value: `copilot`, whose published meaning is "an AI assistant's tool writing on a person's behalf", which only an in-process caller may state (every HTTP door refuses `?surface=copilot`). Studio already renders it as an AI draft mark. Adding `in_app` would widen a published accept set (Clause-② yes) and touch `packages/spec` and Studio's rendering for no new distinction, so this PR adds no enum member and does not touch `packages/spec`.

## Tests

New top-level group in the door's shared harness `packages/runtime/src/domains/mcp-authoring.test.ts`, through the real entry on a host kernel (the `dispatchAction` pins' kernel shape):

- the entry is the package's public export;
- an admitted person is listed exactly the MCP door's five tool definitions (deep-equal to the MCP door's `getAll()`), with no publish tool, and a read is served;
- a person without `manage_metadata` is listed nothing, and every one of the five tools is refused with the MCP door's `code`/`status`, before any protocol read;
- a draft save stamps `surface: 'copilot'`, no `client`, `actor` = the person, and answers the publish verdict and Studio routes; the MCP door's save in the same test still stamps `mcp` + `client`;
- the writer is the MCP door's: a walled tenancy posture refuses the save `403` before any write;
- fail closed: no user, `isSystem`, a throwing grant read;
- placement: a named environment scopes every service lookup; a refusing `kernel-resolver` rejects with no grant read.

Ablations (on the committed tree, restored with `git checkout HEAD --`): hard-coding the save's surface to `'mcp'` reds the provenance test; dropping the `isSystem` guard reds the fail-closed test.

## Acceptance notes

- File surface beyond the original claim (`http-dispatcher.ts`, `action-dispatch.ts`, the new `in-process-authoring.ts`) was confirmed by the seat before push (claim amendment 7219051191). The entry file sits in `src/`, not `src/domains/`: every file under `domains/` must declare an HTTP route envelope (`check:route-envelope`), and this one serves no route; the seat recorded the move in claim amendment 2 (7219506629), and `check-route-envelope.mjs` is unchanged. `content/docs/permissions/system-context.mdx` (row 61c) is the census page `check:system-context-census` requires for the new `isSystem` read. `overlap-check.mjs --pr=37896` (the open PR that also edits `action-dispatch.ts`): `VERDICT clean exit 0`, both merge cleanly.
- The first commit on the branch (`1c78bfc0`, a WIP push) carries no trailer pair; the second carries the model-free pair.
- Public API record: the runtime package has no generated API report (`api-surface/` is `packages/spec` only); the export is recorded in `src/index.ts` with its comment and in the changeset.

## Verification

<details><summary>Local runs and CI (head 7fea375d, merge base bc173343)</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/domains/mcp-authoring.test.ts src/action-dispatch.test.ts src/action-confirmation-handoff-33690.test.ts` (under `os-verify-lock.sh`, head 7fea375d): Test Files 3 passed, Tests 172 passed, `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime typecheck`: `tsc --noEmit` clean; `check:test-typecheck` reports 3 files that import `@objectstack/driver-turso`, which this container did not build (TS2307, none touched here). CI's `Type Check · workspace` and `TypeScript Type Check` are green.
- Derived gates (`dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`, 73 commands): 70 exit 0. `check:plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exit 3 (prerequisite dist not built here; CI green). `check:query-options-erasure` exited 1 only because the file moved mid-run (ENOENT on the old path) and exits 0 when re-run on the final tree. `check:route-envelope`, `check:system-context-census` and `check:doc-anchors` exit 0. `check:published-readme-exports` answers NOT MEASURED (exit 3) locally; CI is its verdict.
- CI at 7fea375d: 55 check runs, 40 success, 15 skipped (UI, opt-in and queue lanes), 0 failed; including `Lint & Repo Gates`, `TypeScript Type Check`, `Test Core` (10/10 shards), `Build Core`, `Build Docs`, `Check Changeset`, `PR-body guards`.

</details>

Two-minute check: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run src/domains/mcp-authoring.test.ts -t 37944` shows 7 passing cases.
